rows.idea: Build a verified multi-season database of player-prop opening and closing lines & vig
rows.evidence: Ex-ante trailing prop calibration achieves MAE 59.4 pass yds / 26.9 rush yds / 28.4 rec yds (r=0.22..0.31), yet 0 historical prop sportsbook prices exist anywhere in the repo (FL-01).

rows.recommended_path: DEFER STAKING — Publish stat forecast accuracy only; withhold all prop ROI/edge claims until >= 2 seasons of real prop odds are archived.

rows.idea: Condition team-margin Ridge origination on confirmed QB tenure & WR1/RB1 availability
rows.evidence: Team-stat-only Ridge has 10.284 MAE vs market 9.737 MAE (residual slope = -0.1453, p = 0.228); meanwhile within-season backup QBs (<5 starts, n=438) score 18.13 PPG (-5.47 PPG vs incumbent QB1).
rows.expected_impact: Prevents stale team ratings from misquoting backup-QB games like MIA@IND (McCord), LA@ARI (Beck), and SEA@LV (Lock).
rows.recommended_path: BUILD — Add explicit ex-ante starter/backup adjustment term in benchmark origination.

rows.idea: Weight Net EPA/gm (r=0.491) heavily over Win%-Pyth% residuals (r=0.059) and 1-score record (r=0.050)
rows.evidence: Through 2026 Week 9, DEN is 7-2 with 6-0 in 1-score games (+2.17 luck wins, -0.32 Net EPA/gm) while TB is 3-6 with 0-6 in 1-score games (-2.17 luck wins, +3.66 Net EPA/gm); yet blind luck-fade S4 returned -6.45% ROI because markets already discount standings.
rows.expected_impact: Improves power-rating stability without falling into naive 'fade lucky team blindly' trap.
rows.recommended_path: BUILD — Incorporate EPA-weighted strength in power ratings; reject naive standalone luck-fade bets.

rows.idea: Benchmark quoted SGP payouts against bivariate Gaussian copula probabilities
rows.evidence: Empirical 2018-2026 correlations reach r=0.5640 (QB pass yds <-> WR1 rec yds -> 34.54% copula joint probability = +190 fair vs +300 naive) and r=0.3372 (RB1 rush yds <-> margin); DraftKings SGPs price correlation internally.
rows.expected_impact: Identifies toxic anti-correlated SGP legs and measures exact parlay vig haircut.
rows.recommended_path: BUILD — Keep copula pricer as diagnostic calculator; never bet SGPs blindly assuming +300 independence.

rows.idea: Maintain 10-gate hard filter (NIST z-test, BH FDR q<0.10, Empirical Bayes > 0%) before capital allocation
rows.evidence: 0 of 8 tested strategies pass all 10 gates: even S1_DIV_DOG (+5.36% ROI) and S3_HIGH_WIND_UNDER (+9.20% ROI) fail NIST z (p=0.295 / 0.221), BH FDR (q=0.437), and EB shrinkage (-2.14% / -2.79%).
rows.expected_impact: Protects bankroll from overfitting finite-sample noise and market vig.
rows.recommended_path: KEEP — Maintain strict 0% live bankroll deployment posture.
